name: folder
description: A solid horizontal folder with a straight negative-space panel divider.
authorship: Original filled geometry constructed for Squircle Icons; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: A fill-only companion to Outline Folder. The outer bounds x=2.125..21.875 and y=4.125..19.875 match the visible Outline bounds at its default 1.75 stroke. One evenodd compound path cuts a straight 1.75-unit divider slot into the solid silhouette. Rounded outer corners preserve the real folder tab; no stroke is layered over the fill.
